desc: torchvision in the Python of the run, the mirror of tool/pytorch: detected when it is there, built from source by program/build-pytorchvision against the torch of that Python otherwise (the vision release that pairs with it, or --version), --with.torch=pip for PyTorch's wheel torch first.
note: added on 2026-10-08 with the pairing of program/build-pytorchvision; verified on the P14s Gen 4 (CUDA 13.3)
